- 0.35 anchors: travel bans, police detention patterns, mandatory reporting to accommodation office, health exams, monitored travel status — all universal-exposure, state-directed, systematic with no effective remedy. Here custody is worse (male dorms, head-shaving) but visitor not likely detained.

Around 0.50–0.55 seems right. Societal hostility: documented killings patterned, service exclusion with impunity, but also public apology, statutes penalizing slurs, elected trans legislator, school policy — a mixed picture with real societal friction/hostility and thin national recourse but localized protections.
